title: The First Finite-Return Casepack: A Worked Case Showing Finite Re-Entry Under a Frozen Grammar
object_of_study: finite re-entry after a declared local wound under unchanged rules
main_question: Does the candidate returned state achieve finite admissible re-entry under the same frozen grammar that measured its departure?

claim_layers.claim: Admissible re-entry can be determined, typed, and read as an actual result rather than a merely constitutional possibility (Zenodo record description).
The paper is continuity-facing but intentionally limited and establishes finite return as the necessary public step before weld, seam closure, and earned continuity.

preserved_meaning: The source's distinction between finite return as a measured event and continuity as a stronger, not-yet-claimed burden.
distortion_or_substitution_risk: Reading finite return as continuity or weld, or reading a single local episode as a general return law.
